title: Symmetry-Oriented Testing Framework for Variational Quantum Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.29053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Testing quantum software is challenging because quantum states cannot be directly inspected. Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) are a particularly important target as they are among the most promising approaches for near-term noisy quantum hardware. Many testing methods rely on classically computed results, which conflicts with the regime where quantum advantage is expected. Although prior studies mitigate this oracle problem, the core difficulty remains that existing approaches do not verify whether the execution deviates from the intended problem or whether the obtained solution is physically plausible. translated_title: 面向对称性的变分量子算法测试框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：测试量子软件极具挑战性，因为量子态无法被直接检查。变分量子算法（VQAs）是尤为重要的测试对象，因为它们是面向近期含噪量子硬件最有前景的方法之一。许多测试方法依赖于经典计算得到的结果，这与预期实现量子优势的场景相冲突。尽管先前的研究缓解了这一预言机问题，但核心困难依然存在：现有方法无法验证程序执行是否偏离了预期问题，也无法验证所获得的解在物理上是否合理。我们提出了一个面向对称性的变分量子算法测试框架，通过使用与目标哈密顿量对易的算符作为测试规范来填补这一空白。该框架提供了两种互补的诊断手段：一种基于对易子的健康检查，用于监控优化过程中每个执行步骤是否保持一致（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种面向对称性的变分量子算法测试框架，以与目标哈密顿量对易的算符作为测试规范，解决了现有方法无法验证量子程序执行是否偏离预期问题、所求解是否物理合理的难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a symmetry-oriented testing framework for variational quantum algorithms that uses operators commuting with the target Hamiltonian as test specifications, addressing the gap that existing methods cannot verify whether executions deviate from the intended problem or whether obtained solutions are physically plausible.
